schema_canonicalization.separators: compact comma and colon separators without insignificant whitespace
schema_canonicalization.string_encoding: standard JSON escaping with Unicode emitted directly except where JSON escaping is required
schema_canonicalization.per_schema_hash_scope: Canonical serialization of the complete schema record excluding schema_sha256.

schema_set_hash_scope.description: Canonical serialization of an object with the exact keys below. schemas is the ordered array of objects containing only schema_id and schema_sha256. schema_set_sha256, status, and provider_calls_completed are excluded.

strictness.reason: Frozen H3 requires undeclared semantic fields to be detected before normalization can discard them.
strictness.transport_metadata_boundary: Provider request, model, token, latency, cost, and envelope metadata belongs in evaluation result records, not semantic output.

material: retrieval_status selected by the provider or retrieval stage
evidence_type selected by the provider or retrieval stage
trace-backed evidence content produced by the provider or retrieval stage
provider_or_retrieval_produced_untrusted.authority: untrusted semantic material; provider or retrieval origin does not make it authoritative provenance

material: source display name or title as returned
provider-returned URL or reference when exposed
provider citation or reference identifier when exposed
provider_or_trace_derived_untrusted_sour.authority: untrusted source display or reference data; it never overrides harness-owned canonical provenance

additional_trace_authority: provider citation to retrieval trace to canonical source mapping
observed retrieval or tool transport success or failure captured by trace; not retrieval_status selection
harness_authoritative_provenance.derivation: captured retrieval or tool trace under frozen deterministic harness policies; never model prose

not_semantic_repair_when_all: the canonical value derives directly or deterministically from captured trace
field ownership is declared harness-side by this contract
before and after hashes are preserved
the provider did not own the canonical field

h3_boundary.model_owned_final_outputs: H3 examines the unfiltered strict parsed semantic payload before any normalization can discard extras.
h3_boundary.retrieval_stage: Canonical bundle construction is not insertion into a model-owned final semantic payload because canonical provenance fields are harness-owned.

allowed_canonical_content: provider-returned search snippet tied to captured trace
deterministic structured extraction from trace-backed content

final_search_id_ownership.source_reference_policy: The model selects only existing canonical source IDs from the validated retrieval evidence bundle; the harness validates membership and never repairs a broken reference.

null_and_optional.meaningful_zero_results: use explicit empty arrays where the schema allows them
null_and_optional.provider_failure_representation: do not manufacture a semantic result

evaluation_only_v1_decisions.scope: New evaluation-owned search and retrieval fields only; these limits do not alter the production text contract.

format_assertion.canonical_validator_requirement: The canonical validator must actively assert every declared format and must not rely on a library's default format behavior.
format_assertion.failure_result: A value that fails an asserted format is a canonical schema validation failure.

provider_adapter_boundary.canonical_schema_role: The provider-neutral semantic contracts used for evaluation; retrieval_evidence_bundle_v1 is a harness-assembled canonical bundle and untrusted synthesis input rather than a model-owned final semantic payload.
provider_adapter_boundary.provider_native_schema_role: A syntax-only translation when a provider requires a different schema representation.
adapters_may: translate canonical schema syntax to provider-native syntax
map provider citation IDs to trace-owned canonical source IDs
preserve provider retrieval evidence and references in captured trace for harness bundle construction
adapters_must_not: insert missing fields into model-owned semantic payloads
turn invalid semantic output into valid output
provider_adapter_boundary.model_output_canonical_validation_bounda: The extracted raw model-owned semantic object must pass the canonical schema before semantic normalization or grading.
provider_adapter_boundary.retrieval_bundle_canonical_validation_bo: Trace-backed retrieval material is preserved, explicit harness-owned provenance is attached under the logged ownership allowlist, and the resulting harness-assembled canonical bundle must then pass canonical schema and retrieval coherence validation.

on_canonical_schema_failure: preserve the raw semantic payload locally under the frozen privacy policy and record its hash
retry only according to the separately frozen retry policy
never promote malformed partial output to partial success
safe_failure.exhausted_ordinary_run: Fail the applicable hard gate and assign zero to every applicable quality criterion for that run.

leakage_boundary.schemas_may_contain_only: provider-visible output-contract semantics or explicitly declared harness-owned provenance in the canonical retrieval bundle supplied as untrusted synthesis input

rules: No indicators or only low-severity indicators require risk_level low.
At least one medium-severity indicator and no high-severity indicator require risk_level medium.
Any high-severity indicator requires risk_level high.
Risk level low requires recommendation buy.
Risk level medium requires recommendation caution.
Risk level high requires recommendation avoid.
price_plausibility does not independently determine risk_level or recommendation.
retrieval_status is selected by the provider or retrieval stage and must be completed, partial, or no_reliable_evidence
missing or invalid retrieval_status is a canonical schema failure; the harness never generates, infers, inserts, replaces, upgrades, downgrades, or repairs it
source_id values are generated deterministically by the harness from canonical trace ordering and are unique within the bundle
evidence_id values are generated deterministically by the harness from canonical source and evidence ordering and are unique within the bundle
evidence_type is selected by the provider or retrieval stage and must match the canonical enum
missing or invalid evidence_type is a canonical schema failure; the harness never generates, infers, maps, inserts, replaces, or repairs it
a schema-valid evidence_type must pass evidence_trace_coherence_validator_v1 against its trace-backed content before the item or bundle can be accepted for synthesis
completed or partial retrieval contains at least one source
no_reliable_evidence may contain zero sources
retrieved_at comes exclusively from harness retrieval or response capture and is canonical UTC RFC3339 date-time rather than model invention
every canonical source URL is the exact final trace-owned retrieved URL, or the trace-owned requested URL only when no final URL exists and trace establishes that source identity
source_type is assigned by the harness under the future frozen source-classification policy
provider-proposed canonical provenance is preserved only as untrusted trace metadata and never overrides harness authority
canonical evidence content is limited to a trace-captured raw excerpt, a provider-returned search snippet tied to trace, or a deterministic structured extraction from trace-backed content
a free-form model-written summary without trace-backed content cannot become canonical evidence content
the evidence bundle hash matches canonical serialized data
every source belongs to the actual captured retrieval trace
construction_flow: provider or search or tool retrieval
preserve provider-produced retrieval_status, evidence_type, evidence content, and returned reference material
attach canonical source_type under the frozen classification policy
other applicable retrieval trace and reference validation
provide validated bundle as untrusted synthesis input

evidence_trace_coherence_validator_v1.failure_category_scope: A schema-valid evidence_type is materially inconsistent with its trace-backed evidence content or cannot be deterministically supported; this is distinct from canonical schema failure and the separate public-prose evidence policy.
evidence_trace_coherence_validator_v1.validation_scope: every canonical retrieval evidence item after canonical JSON Schema validation and before retrieval_status coherence validation, bundle freeze, or synthesis
validator_inputs: schema-valid evidence_type from the original provider or retrieval result

evidence_type_support_rules.identity: Trace-backed content must materially identify the product, model, variant, or SKU.
evidence_type_support_rules.status: Trace-backed content must materially state lifecycle, release, current, discontinued, or equivalent product status.
evidence_type_support_rules.specification: Trace-backed content must materially state a product specification, feature, dimension, compatibility fact, or model-specific technical detail.
evidence_type_support_rules.price: Trace-backed content must contain a concrete price or amount, or deterministically extracted price evidence; merely mentioning the word price is insufficient.
evidence_type_support_rules.availability: Trace-backed content must materially state availability such as in stock, unavailable, preorder, sold, or an equivalent trace-backed availability state.
evidence_type_support_rules.condition: Trace-backed content must materially state item condition, wear, refurbishment, damage, or an equivalent condition fact.
evidence_type_support_rules.warranty: Trace-backed content must materially state warranty coverage, duration, exclusion, expiration, or an equivalent warranty fact.
evidence_type_support_rules.bundle: Trace-backed content must materially state package, bundle, included-item, or excluded-item information.
evidence_type_support_rules.regional_context: Trace-backed content must materially state region, currency, market, distribution, import, or equivalent regional context.
evidence_type_support_rules.other_material: Trace-backed content must be materially relevant to a frozen retrieval objective, fit no more specific evidence_type, and must not be irrelevant filler or untraceable model prose.

allowed_methods: future frozen parser or classification policies
deterministic_boundary.borderline_human_adjudication_policy: The item remains excluded from validated canonical evidence and scored synthesis unless a future versioned policy resolves the case.

rules: evidence_type must already be schema-valid before evidence and trace coherence validation begins
evidence content must be trace-backed under the frozen evidence-content policy
trace-backed content must materially support the semantic class declared by evidence_type under the matching frozen support rule
content that does not materially support the declared evidence_type fails with failed_evidence_trace_coherence
the harness may reject but never replace, repair, reclassify, or choose a better evidence_type
source_type cannot establish or imply evidence_type; actual trace-backed content must support the declared evidence_type
failure remains attached to the original provider or retrieval attempt
a failed item or result is not promoted into the validated canonical retrieval bundle used for synthesis
the harness does not silently remove a failed item and recalculate, infer, or replace retrieval_status
retrieval_status remains the original provider or retrieval-selected value and the attempt fails the applicable validation path
any later retry is governed only by the future frozen retry policy

retrieval_status_ownership.harness_role: validate the selected status against canonical schema, captured trace, retained evidence, and frozen coherence rules

validator_inputs: harness-owned objective applicability and support classifications

harness_classification_contract.objective_classification_authority: future deterministic harness operating on the frozen objective set and captured trace; never model prose; these support classifications validate but do not select retrieval_status
classification_inputs: target condition and bundle when applicable

completed.required_material_objective_support: every objective classified material_required has support_status sufficient
completed.optional_absence_policy: An objective classified optional_absence_permitted or not_applicable does not prevent completed.

no_reliable_evidence.retained_evidence_policy: Retained evidence may be weak, insufficient, ambiguous, conflicting, irrelevant to the exact target, stale for the current claim, or mismatched by region, condition, or bundle.
no_reliable_evidence.contradiction_failure: Fail when any material_required objective has support_status sufficient while retrieval_status is no_reliable_evidence.

tool_and_transport_failure_boundary.no_reliable_evidence_is_valid_only_when: The provider or retrieval stage produced a canonical schema-valid semantic result and retained evidence and trace coherently support no_reliable_evidence.

retrieval_status_coherence_validator_v1.semantic_boundary: Retrieval-status coherence determines whether retrieval produced usable evidence for synthesis. It does not determine final identity, final comparison_status, market value, or a final price conclusion; the bundle remains untrusted synthesis input.

rules: all evaluation-owned IDs are unique within their namespaces
every referenced source ID exists in the validated retrieval evidence bundle and the same final result
every final source record is an unchanged selected projection of a canonical source record in the validated retrieval evidence bundle
every price evidence source exists in the validated retrieval evidence bundle
claim_id, price_evidence_id, uncertainty_id, and conflict_id are required model-generated semantic fields and are never inserted or repaired by the harness
every conflict has at least two unique valid source IDs
resolved identity requires resolved_product_identity and at least one valid source ID
unresolved identity forbids resolved_product_identity and resolved_variant_or_sku
conflicting identity requires at least two unique valid source IDs and an identity or variant conflict referencing the conflicting evidence
current or discontinued current_status requires at least one valid supporting source ID
conflicting current_status requires at least two unique valid source IDs and a status conflict referencing the conflicting evidence
comparison_status established satisfies the established coherence specification
comparison_status partially_established satisfies the partial coherence specification
comparison_status not_established satisfies the not-established coherence specification
range minimum is less than or equal to range maximum
retrieval timestamps, URLs, and source types exactly match the canonical harness-owned values in the validated retrieval bundle and captured trace
no source is fabricated
material current claims have supporting source references

resolved.source_reference_policy: Every source_id resolves to a source in the same result.
resolved.resolved_variant_or_sku_policy: Optional only when the exact variant or SKU cannot legitimately be established or is not applicable.

unresolved.populated_source_ids_meaning: Evidence was considered but was insufficient to resolve identity.

conflicting.conflict_reference_policy: The required conflict record references the conflicting valid source IDs.

current.support_requirement: Referenced trace-backed evidence supports current status.

discontinued.support_requirement: Referenced trace-backed evidence supports discontinued status.

conflicting.conflict_reference_policy: The required status conflict record references the conflicting valid source IDs.

not_established.populated_source_ids_meaning: Evidence was considered but was insufficient to establish current or discontinued status.

explicitly_allowed_combinations: unresolved identity with not_established current status
resolved identity with not_established current status
conflicting identity with not_established current status

established.source_policy: Every material current conclusion has valid supporting source references.
established.conflict_policy: No unresolved conflict makes the frozen requested comparison materially ambiguous.
established.sufficiency_policy: Evidence is sufficient for the actual frozen comparison objective without unsupported precision.

partially_established.support_policy: At least one material requested conclusion is traceably established and at least one remains unresolved, insufficient, conflicting, or unavailable.
partially_established.identity_policy: Identity may be resolved, unresolved, or conflicting only when returned conclusions do not pretend that an unresolved exact target is established.

search_cross_reference_validator_v1.semantic_boundary: Citation entailment and claim quality remain human or semantic adjudication where deterministic checks are insufficient.

rules: every photo_number is less than or equal to the actual supplied image count
separate_semantic_hard_gates: current market price or value claims

ownership_model.provider_proposed_provenance: preserve as untrusted trace metadata when exposed; never use as canonical authority

harness_construction_invariants.retrieval_status_policy: The provider or retrieval stage selects retrieval_status; missing or invalid values fail canonical schema validation and the harness never generates, infers, inserts, replaces, upgrades, downgrades, or repairs the value.
harness_construction_invariants.source_id_policy: Generate deterministically from canonical trace ordering; provider omission is allowed and provider invention is non-authoritative trace metadata.
harness_construction_invariants.evidence_id_policy: Generate deterministically from canonical source and evidence ordering; provider omission is allowed and evidence_id is not a provider-quality criterion.
harness_construction_invariants.evidence_type_policy: The provider or retrieval stage selects evidence_type; missing or invalid values fail canonical schema validation, a schema-valid value inconsistent with trace-backed content fails evidence_trace_coherence_validator_v1, and the harness never generates, infers, maps, inserts, replaces, repairs, reclassifies, or chooses a better value.
harness_construction_invariants.source_display_name_policy: Use a provider-returned or trace-derived display name with representation-only normalization under a documented rule; the text remains untrusted.
harness_construction_invariants.url_policy: Use the exact final trace-owned retrieved URL; when unavailable, use the trace-owned requested URL only where trace establishes source identity.
harness_construction_invariants.retrieved_at_policy: Use harness retrieval or response capture serialized as canonical UTC RFC3339 date-time.
harness_construction_invariants.source_type_policy: Assign under the future frozen source-classification policy; provider proposals are non-authoritative.
harness_construction_invariants.evidence_content_policy: Allow only trace-captured raw excerpts, provider-returned snippets tied to trace, or deterministic structured extraction from trace-backed content.

preserve provider-returned evidence and reference material
attach canonical source_type under the frozen classification policy
other applicable retrieval trace and reference validation
